name: Sierra de Fuentes (Spain)
description: Seven horizontal stripes of yellow and green alternating, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sierra de Fuentes (a castle on red and a lion above a fountain).
history: Municipal flag of Sierra de Fuentes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Sierra de Fuentes arms — castle, lion and fountain
